title: His father Leon Summers, bassist with Claiborne Williams
summary: His father L.M. Leon Summers, from Louisiana, played string bass with Claiborne Williams around 1916-17 and died in 1956 aged 80.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I never even thought about it when you said the 15th was yesterday. Can you tell us some more about your father? About how old was he and when did he die? Is he still living? He died in 1956. He was 80 years old. 80 years. 80 years old. 80 years old when he died. Did he ever talk about the music? Did he come from up in that part of the area? He come from up there. He come from Moreau, Louisiana. Did he ever play down here that you know? He played with Claiborne Williams. He used to play all around. He used to go all around. He played with Claiborne Williams about the year of 1916 and 17. Did he ever tell you anything about the music when he was a boy up in that part of the country? What kind of dance bands they had I wondered?
He didn't ever tell me anything about the dance bands he had. I remember a couple of you had dance bands.
You heard some when you were a boy too. Did you ever hear the Claiborne Williams? No doubt you did. Oh yeah, sure.
I heard them. Lots of times.
That's before my time. Some of the members are still playing I think up there. Some of the members.
But all those members is dead out now. I don't play with my daddy.
What was your father's name then?
Had he played anything except the string bass? That's all he played, the string bass. Do you remember, were there any brass bands up there that had parades like they do here?
No, they didn't have no brass band up there that they have, yeah.
